d:
"Ever wonder how Dr Abigail Wilson got her 3rd breast? I decided I wanted to do an image sequence explaining that... and it kinda grew out into a comic, that I've been very slowly working on for the last few months. But here we are, with the Dr badging in at her job, and making an unfortunate discovery... Let me know what you think!

Page 2 of this comic. Getting right down to it, and getting started on that fateful experiment. Probably gotta work on the flavor of those things...

Page 3! Oops, that formula seems to be not quite right.

aaand Page 4, looks like a satisfactory end result...Thanks for reading!" - Artist
